lessons_text:
Lessons from earlier sessions in this repository (they were written after a failure was fixed; check each against the code before relying on it):
L1. When Adding a new operation under src/ops/ in this repo, or writing tests for one: Put each operation's tests in its own file at tests/ops/<operation>.spec.ts, matching the source module name exactly, since house-rules enforces this in pretest. (seen: npm test failed pretest with "src/ops/split.ts has no test file tests/ops/split.spec.ts"; moving tests/split.spec.ts to tests/ops/split.spec.ts made it pass.)
